<a name="RunManagedPathsTests"></a>
## func RunManagedPathsTests

```go
func RunManagedPathsTests(t *testing.T, fn func([]string) ([]string, error), config ManagedPathsTestConfig)
```

RunManagedPathsTests runs the shared validation tests for NewManagedPaths using the given function under test. Each agent package should call this to validate the common contract without duplicating test logic.

<a name="ManagedPathsTestConfig"></a>
## type ManagedPathsTestConfig

ManagedPathsTestConfig holds the parameters for testing NewManagedPaths through a target adapter. Each agent package calls RunManagedPathsTests with its own native paths and expected error patterns.

```go
type ManagedPathsTestConfig struct {
    // Label is the target adapter name (e.g. "Codex", "Claude", "OpenCode").
    Label string
    // NativePaths are the adapter's hardcoded managed paths.
    NativePaths []string
    // DuplicatePath is a native path to use for the duplicate rejection test.
    DuplicatePath string
}
```
